Variants.Content: King Attalus I of Pergamon, ruler of an opulent Hellenistic realm in northwest Asia Minor, formed a pivotal naval alliance with Rome during the First Macedonian War. Facing aggressive expansion from Philip V of Macedon, Attalus committed his fleet to joint operations with Roman squadrons across the Aegean, establishing Pergamon as Rome's indispensable gateway into the politics of the Greek East.
